request.prompt: Premium fantasy mobile RPG skill VFX, hand-painted with luminous volumetric light, bright white-hot cores fading into rich saturated colour, fine sparks and particles, soft glow, NO outlines, NO cartoon line art. IMPORTANT: the whole image is one continuous solid pure black background; every cell sits on the same pure black, no grey, white or coloured cell backgrounds. A sprite sheet: 16 sequential animation frames of ONE effect in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, the effect centred in each cell with black margin all round so nothing touches a cell edge, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a flaming meteor falling from the sky onto the ground. Frames 1 to 4: a burning rock with a long fiery tail streaks down from the top of the cell toward the bottom centre. Frames 5 to 7: it strikes the bottom centre in a white-hot flash. Frames 8 to 12: a dome of fire and flying rock debris bursts outward from the impact. Frames 13 to 16: smoke and embers fade until the last frame is nearly black.
